browser: Chromium via the Playwright MCP server
build: npm install and npm run build at the worktree root, npm --prefix ramify-agent ci, then npm run build:web

console.session: 0 messages of any level for the whole session (browser_console_messages level=debug all=true)

shell.note: main.route-run lifts the 52rem cap; .run-page > * keeps the 52rem measure and only .area-wide (Progress) uses the full width.

narrow.layout: detail panel stacked below the canvas
narrow.minimap: hidden below 480px of canvas width, by the canvas's own container query

focusedRow.note: Focus reached check-060 with a focus ring after a real Tab press set the keyboard modality. The canvas pans at the current zoom, which is unchanged by the pan.

breakpointSweep.note: Fitted zoom of the same tree with the detail panel beside the canvas and stacked below it, at a 1000px viewport height. 0.354 is twice the 0.177 the capability plan recorded.
breakpointSweep.chosen: 82rem (1312px): the panel stacks below at and under it, and stays beside the canvas above it.

canvasHeightSweep.tree: sixtyRows, 2024 x 2853, canvas 1392 wide at a 1000px viewport height

canvasFocusDefect.found: Chromium scrolls React Flow's own element to reveal a focused row (measured offsets 564 left, 1108 top) and React Flow resets that scroll a moment later.
canvasFocusDefect.effect: The canvas measured the revealed box, read the row as already in view, and never panned. jsdom applies no such scroll, so iteration 4's unit tests passed.
canvasFocusDefect.correction: ModuleTreeCanvas undoes the ancestor scroll before it measures.
